proof.statement: 两枚封签分别归属独立根 root-A 与 root-B,签核代均未被撤销,摘要与证据一致
两名复核人 rev-3、rev-4 的委托链同受根 root-C 控制,不构成独立批准

chaos.name: s1-revoke-before-commit
chaos.expect: 撤销先提交后,旧签核代承诺被拒;强写承诺+回执的包恢复后仍不通过
chaos.observed: commit rejected (commit rejected: seal seal-C1-old not currently valid); replay after forced commit+receipt still rejects: rule=insufficient-valid-seals

proof.statement: 有效封签不足两枚(有效 0,无效 1)

extra.seal-C1-old: revoked-generation: seal gen 2 <= revoked gen 2 (root root-D)

chaos.name: s2-lost-receipt
chaos.expect: 承诺后回执丢失→恢复后不生效;迟到回执落在撤销之后→重放仍否决
chaos.observed: crash recovery: rule=receipt-missing; late receipt rejected (receipt rejected: fewer than 2 currently valid seals); forced receipt replay: rule=insufficient-valid-seals

proof.statement: 有效封签不足两枚(有效 0,无效 2)

extra.seal-C2-1: revoked-generation: seal gen 1 <= revoked gen 1 (root root-E)
extra.seal-C2-2: revoked-generation: seal gen 1 <= revoked gen 1 (root root-E)

chaos.name: s3-same-number-digest-conflict
chaos.expect: 同编号两份承诺摘要冲突,恢复后整体否决
chaos.observed: two conflicting commits on PKG-C3 detected; replay rejects: rule=digest-conflict

proof.statement: 编号 PKG-C3 存在 2 份承诺,摘要互相冲突,全部不予承认
